name: 363-hug
notes: #363 B7.d as the game triggers it (user 2026-11-06 'Hugs are fine. Add them.'; View/HugDirector.cs): a reunion. The hunter is home with the catch (the hunt's CarryBack turns to Skin at the fire, the hide in hand, a bundle); their partner, sitting out 0.9 u off, gets up and they meet halfway: arms wide on the way in, wrap (arms x85, z inward 10, squash .92, lean 10) with the hit on arrival, hold 1.2 s swaying roll +-6 at 1 Hz in opposite directions, step back 0.05 u with a tiny hop, arms drop; then the hunter goes on to skin the catch. Not forced: BeatFlags.Hugs is on by default. Rare on purpose: a pair once a view day, 2-6 hugs a day in the box by population, none within 25 s of another (Life/HugRules.cs). The other triggers: the wedding's join after the vow (370-wedding), two rivals the leader stepped between as their bicker ends, a parent and a kid at dawn or in the evening (363-hug-parent-kid). knownGaps react: the partner answers in its pose (wraps, squashes) on the hug's own frame, which the bench can't see as an answer. AnimLab: cheat 'Hug now' (the two nearest), or a hunt with a catch near a partner.
